issue: ǵʰésores h₂uksént: plural for a natural pair of hands (dual expected); trémt: athematic imperfect, the root is thematic *trém-e- (Gk trémō, Lat tremō); also voc. ph₂tér has final accent where the vocative should take initial accent (Skt pítar, Gk páter)
déwkti: athematic present for *dewk- 'draw', which is thematic *déwk-e- (Lat dūcō, Goth tiuhan)
sth₂tóm: 2nd DUAL aorist imperative, but the addressee HéHḱewes h₁éḱwōs is plural (2pl sth₂té). Also tósmead: nonstandard abl. for *tósmōd (Skt tásmāt); duként: athematic *dewk- (thematic expected)

Scholarly (Lehmann-Zgusta type) line in pre-laryngeal notation without accents (owis, eḱwobʰ(y)os, nerm̥, aǵontm̥ for *h₂ówis, *h₁éḱwo-, *h₂nérm̥, *h₂éǵontm̥); parenthesized alternative (eḱwomos) left in running text; augmented ewewkʷet is post-PIE. Meaning is correct
ḱéywosdʰh₂: MIDDLE 1st DUAL present ('we two lie'); the dog says 'I lie', which needs 1sg ḱéyh₂er. Also tósmead: nonstandard abl. for *tósmōd
tód némos léyǵʰti: némos is used two sentences earlier for 'the place of sacrifice', so it reads 'he licks the sanctuary' rather than 'the sacrifice' (the offering)

tóns wiHróns h₂éǵet: object pronoun next to a goal accusative reads first as 'he drove those men'; context gives 'drove them to the men' (ambiguous, not changed). Also tónoh₁: nonstandard instr. for *tóh₁; tósmead for *tósmōd; n̥ptés: gen. of népōts with syllabic n̥ (expected *népotos/*neptés); déwkt: athematic *dewk-
tónoh₁ (in tónoh₁ gʷréwh₁): nonstandard instr. of the demonstrative, expected *tóh₁

tósmead: nonstandard abl. for *tósmōd; só tósyo ǵʰésorn̥s tl̥néh₂t: non-reflexive tósyo right after tósyo = the king's son, so it can be read as 'he lifted the son's hands' (a reflexive *swé-/*séwe would be unambiguous)
déh₃tor: masculine agent noun addressed to Dawn (h₂éwsos), fem. *déh₃trih₂ expected; tósmead: nonstandard abl. for *tósmōd
ḱléwesbʰis: INSTRUMENTAL PLURAL of ḱléwos; 'your fame is great' needs nom. sg. ḱléwos (as in the formula elsewhere)

wódr̥h₂ HéHḱuh₂ h₁sént: neuter plural subject with a plural verb (neut. pl. takes a 3sg verb), and wódr̥h₂ is a mechanical plural for the collective *wédōr; déh₃tor (masc.) and déywih₂ (fem.) for a river referred to with neuter tód; márkom: marginal northwestern word where h₁éḱwom would do
h₁édm̥: 1st SG imperfect ('I was eating'); the subject is táwros, which needs 3sg h₁édt. Also péth₂r̥h₂ bʰérǵʰonth₂ h₁sénti: neuter plural with a plural verb; sprongʰós: marginal word
tósmead: nonstandard abl. for *tósmōd
h₁opéyetom: 2nd DUAL imperfect; subject téh₂es h₂óweyes is 3rd plural, so 'they gave' needs h₁opéyont

Scholarly (Lehmann-Zgusta type) text in pre-laryngeal notation without accents (owis, eḱwons, gʷr̥um, meǵm̥); ōku has a plain velar for *h₁ṓḱu (Skt āśú-); augmented eest is post-PIE. Meaning is correct
wiHrós yemHós-kʷe ... tḱyént and dʰéǵʰōm tḗtḱomes: plural verbs for a pair (dual expected); tósyeh₂i: nonstandard fem. loc. of the demonstrative (cf. Skt tásyām)
déwkti: athematic present for *dewk-, which is thematic *déwk-e- (Lat dūcō, Goth tiuhan)
wérunos: speculative theonym (the Varuṇa/Ouranos equation is contested); wéwked with sandhi -d. Grammar and meaning are correct
yemHṓs ... h₂éǵonti (and the plural forms that follow): the divine Twins are a pair and should be dual (cf. Ved. aśvínā)
trémt: athematic imperfect, the root is thematic *trém-e- (Gk trémō, Lat tremō)
